examples.description: Complete the one-time LHDN supplier profile

failure_modes.recovery: Fix the named field — the error carries the expected format.
failure_modes.when: the TIN fails the Malaysian format check, state_code is not an LHDN state code, or a required profile field is missing

preconditions: Singleton per tenant — saving again updates the one profile row.
This profile is the supplier party of every generated e-invoice; complete it before myinvois_invoice_generate.

description: [REQUIRES APPROVAL] Save the one-time LHDN supplier profile — the door checks for an existing row on your tenant and creates or updates in place, so this is the only write you ever call. Validates the TIN format, checks msic_code is a 5-digit MSIC code, and checks state_code against the LHDN state table before the row moves. NEXT: myinvois_invoice_generate reads this profile as the supplier party of every e-invoice.
name: myinvois_settings_save
